minutes.headline: Open Space Committee heard residents oppose Parmenter Road as a kayak access site; no recommendation voted on.
minutes.summary: The committee approved January minutes, then discussed a draft memo recommending that the Parmenter Road parcel move to Parks and Rec care and control for car-top kayak and canoe access. Members disagreed on how much detail to include versus a simple transfer recommendation. Many neighbors objected on safety, congestion, slope, easement and cost grounds. The Reservoir Road parcel cannot be addressed until its title is cleared.

what_happened.line: The Open Space Committee voted no recommendation on the Parmenter Road parcel; it discussed a draft memo to move it to Parks and Rec for car-top kayak access.
Many residents objected to the Parmenter Road site, citing safety, traffic, a steep slope, a storm drain easement and accessibility costs.
Members disagreed on whether the memo should carry detail or be a simple transfer recommendation, and the Conservation Commission chair advised keeping it simple.
The Reservoir Road parcel cannot be addressed until its title is cleared; the chair will meet Town Counsel in February on three options.
The committee approved the January 11th minutes.

why_it_matters: The Parmenter Road parcel could move to Parks and Rec control for boat access, which would affect the neighborhood around it and could bring site costs, such as accessibility work, to the town budget.
The Reservoir Road alternative depends on a title question that has to be cleared first, so any decision on lake access is likely to take longer.
watch_next: The chair's February follow-up meeting with Town Counsel on clearing the Reservoir Road title.
A revised recommendation memo on the Parmenter Road parcel, and any formal request from the Parks Commission.
